motivation: A reporting-only sensitivity check of the v2.1 recipe (4-match validation models, J03WN1 copy 101) showed spellF1 0.575 -> 0.454 with extra i.i.d. ball noise of 0.5 m, 0.393 with 1.0 m and 0.468 with a slowly varying 1 m bias. v2.1 was trained with ball noise 0.05-0.3 m only. The real tactical ball error is unknown (single wide camera, 1-3 px localisation is roughly 0.1-0.5 m; height and calibration add slowly varying bias), so the model should not depend on sub-0.3 m precision.

candidate.change: only the training-time corruption: ball_sigma_m 0.05-0.6 (was 0.05-0.3) and a new slowly varying ball bias (Gaussian-filtered noise, sd 0-0.6 m, time constant 1-10 s), applied after all v2.1 corruption draws so the v2.1 profile is unchanged
candidate.unchanged: features (v2), stage-1 and stage-2 hyper-parameters, training matches (4 DFL for validation models, 6 DFL for the final bundle), seeds 1-3, step 6, stacking recipe, decoder family
candidate.decoder: re-selected for v2.2 from the same 54-point grid on the combined 16 validation copies

validation.V_orig: the 8 v2.1 validation copies (DFL J03WN1, J03WR9, Metrica 1-2; seeds 101/102; v2.1 corruption)
validation.V_ext: 8 new copies of the same matches (seeds 301/302) with v2.1 corruption plus ball_sigma_m 0.3-0.6 and bias sd 0.2-0.6 m (tau 1-10 s)
validation.comparison: frozen v2.1 recipe models (4-match stage 1 + stage 2 + decoder 3/60/60/-0.3) versus v2.2 models on the same 16 copies

select_v2_2_only_if_all: mean spellF1 over the 16 copies >= v2.1 on the same copies + 0.010
selection_rule.then: final bundle on 6 DFL matches; reserved Metrica game 3 test once with both corruption profiles (2 + 2 copies), reported for v2.1 and v2.2

limits_stated_in_advance: V_ext uses the same four validation matches; the extended error model is a physical prior, not measured on the provided match.
The sensitivity check that motivated this plan used one validation copy; the plan was written before any v2.2 model existed.
